Yes — Mira has a mild egg allergy, confirmed by Riverdale Pediatrics, showing up as hives.

A few things worth passing to a new caregiver:

- Egg (and foods containing it) is the one to avoid — reaction has been mild hives so far.
- Good to mention what a reaction looked like in the past, so they know what to watch for.
- Worth flagging where you keep any antihistamine or a plan from the pediatric office, if you have one on hand.

If it's been a while since Mira was last checked for this, it's worth confirming current severity and any care plan with Riverdale Pediatrics before a caregiver change — allergies can evolve.
